title: Actuators pulled out of portals
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Actuators pulled out of portals, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: that and actuators with this John Silison guy that there's these actuators that they pull out of the portals

plain: A UFO researcher named Grant Cameron, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, passes on what he says he heard from people he names as Ron Pandolfi, Dan Smith and a man called John Sillison. In his telling, there are actuators, parts that make a machine move, which are pulled out of what he calls portals. If true, it would mean someone is retrieving working technology from some other place.
